scope: source-only local transport regression; NOT hosted product acceptance, no provider/VM/credential/workflow/service action
rootCause: Both probes awaited route.fetch (buffers the full body) for a never-ending HTTP 200 text/event-stream response: one rejects on context disposal, the other times out (30000ms in the probe).

fix.sharedTransport: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs (dependency-free; replaces the duplicated helpers in both probes; no node http/https)
fix.sse: GET + Accept text/event-stream: route.fallback() so the browser streams natively; a per-page CDP Fetch guard (context.newCDPSession) adds the bearer to that pinned-BFF request only and strips Authorization/x-tenant-id from any request to another origin (replayed redirect). Decided per actual request, so a response that changes between GETs cannot bypass it. A page without a guard => SSE aborted, no credential.
fix.errors: install returns {errors, assertHealthy}; only closed-target errors with the page/context verifiably closed are ignored; others abort that request and are recorded. Route-load sets the probe error; the acceptance probe throws before continuing.

findingDuringWork: Playwright route.continue({headers}) replays headers on redirects and never re-routes the redirected request (coreBundle _alreadyContinuedParams). The prior header-probe + continue design was reviewed REJECT: two separate GETs, the second can redirect (reproduced by reviewer: foreign origin got the bearer).
